prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. If your insured or any representative has reached out to our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also identify the claim number assigned to this loss and the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, the claim file, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that no evidence is altered, repaired, discarded, or destroyed while this matter is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
